answer: In a decentralized AI agent network, Sybil resistance can be enforced through cryptoeconomic staking where every node must lock native tokens to an immutable anchor on-chain. This economic garden weeds out fake identities by imposing a prohibitive capital cost on attackers; spinning up thousands of virtual agents demands matching financial collateral. Combined with verifiable work proofs, this architecture ensures that any disruptive zephyr of coordinated fake agents rapidly drains the attacker's capital.
